headline.purpose: Roger Wei in the menu bar.

components.name: Painted invert
components.description: Primary HyperCard button; invert is the only emphasis.
components.css: .ds-paint { display: inline-block; padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem; border: 2px solid #000; background: #fff; color: #000; font-family: Silkscreen, monaco, monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-paint-fill, .ds-paint:hover { background: #000; color: #fff; }

components.name: Skip-key on
components.css: .ds-key { display: block; padding: 0.32rem 0.4rem; color: #000; font-family: Silkscreen, monaco, monospace; font-size: 0.62rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-key-on { background: #000; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: The site is one HyperCard field sitting on a grey desk. Skip-keys jump to a window. The world is one-bit: black ink on white paper, painted invert buttons, Chicago-like pixel chrome, Geneva-like body.
keyCharacteristics: One scrolling field. Ten skip-keys. Many small stack windows.
Painted invert buttons, not pills or ghosts.
Plaza Beds grouping in HyperCard chrome.
Empty photo beds stay labeled empty.

rules.name: The One-Bit Rule
rules.body: Do not add a brand color. Invert is the only emphasis.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Pixel type for chrome. Source Sans for sentences.

rules.name: The Window Rule
rules.body: Only stack windows cast a shadow.

dos: Do jump skip-keys to a window in the one field.
Do invert a painted button to mark the primary action.
Do keep empty photo beds empty and labeled.
Do keep Roger's copy, including the spellings he wrote.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color or a color hero.
Don't use Inter, Space Grotesk, Archivo, or another AI-default face.
Don't add a /plaza route or a live-site backup of Plaza Beds.
Don't invent biography, metrics, or testimonials.
